name: TrollPadEx
tagline: 为 iPhone 带来更灵活的多任务、窗口与外接显示体验。
description: TrollPadEx 将熟悉的 iPad 多任务体验带到 iPhone，让应用切换、分屏和窗口管理更加顺手。
各项功能均可在设置中按需开启，适合希望提升大屏利用率和多任务效率的用户。
features: 网格应用切换器与浮动 Dock
分屏浏览、侧拉窗口与多任务按钮
台前调度与外接显示器支持
浮动键盘及常用键盘选项
横屏主屏幕、窗口缩放与显示偏好
compatibility: 台前调度需 iOS 16 或更高版本
usage: 安装后打开“设置”中的 TrollPadEx。
开启需要的多任务、Dock、键盘或显示选项。
iOS 16 可通过控制中心切换多任务模式；较新系统可使用系统的“多任务与手势”设置。
建议逐项启用并确认效果。

changes: 改善台前调度与新系统版本上的使用体验。

en.name: TrollPadEx
en.tagline: Bring more flexible multitasking, windowing, and external display experiences to iPhone.
description: TrollPadEx brings familiar iPad multitasking features to iPhone for easier app switching, split views, and window management.
Features can be enabled individually in Settings to match your preferred multitasking workflow.
features: Grid app switcher and floating Dock
Split View, Slide Over, and multitasking controls
Stage Manager and external display support
Floating keyboard and common keyboard options
Landscape Home Screen, window scaling, and display preferences
compatibility: Stage Manager requires iOS 16 or later
usage: Open TrollPadEx in Settings after installation.
Enable the multitasking, Dock, keyboard, or display options you need.
On iOS 16, switch multitasking modes from Control Center; newer systems can use the system Multitasking & Gestures settings.
Enable options gradually and confirm their effect on your device.

changes: Improved Stage Manager and the experience on newer iOS versions.
